verdict.tagline: Hilarious co-op antics shine despite technical rough edges.
for_you_if: you have friends to play with
you enjoy funny voice chat moments
you can laugh at sudden deaths
not_for_you_if: you need reliable voice chat hardware

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early players struggle with technical bugs and limited content.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game suffers from various bugs, including microphone issues, audio cutting out completely, and settings randomly reverting.

citations.review_text:
Let me start by saying that I know Landfall isn't a live service studio, which certainly isn't a problem and I should also say the amount of respect I have for Landfall is immense, but this has got to be the worst game they have ever released. The content is lackluster, microphone issues occur from time-to-time, and I have even had situations where my settings would revert for some dumb reason, amongst other issues. "Well there are mods" and to be honest with you — Even the mods for this game won't save the game from how boring it can get.

This feels like Landfall's middle child considering how fast the game got abandoned(I know, I speak from experience). In its current state I genuinely cannot recommend this which is a shame, and I do think the game is overpriced. I guess this will be my closer: It's an interesting concept with a decent execution.

I was recommended by a friend to play this game. The whole premise is unique, and the game has a lot of funny moments, but it was ruined by an issue that made the audio in the game completely mute. After doing some research, seems that this issue seems to happen to other people at random intervals. It's a shame, the game is fun, but it's hard to enjoy it when you can't hear the audio on a game that was built around the proximity chat feature.

solo unplayable, one map in some ugly tunnels over and over, online buggy, multiplayer option is through invite code to specific people if you know someone OR join random and if ure unlucky it will keep connecting you to same host, plays a lot of little children who have no clue whats going on i guess, no server browser.

REPO but worse. The slow movement makes it jarring to play multiple times in a row, and the map layout doesn't change (at least from what I saw), so it feels repetitive and boring after a few games.

Gets pretty boring after an hour. Maybe even less. You will need friends to play, which is the whole point of the game, Id say at least 4 people. If you aren't sober it can be more fun. Overall, I had fun for about half the time we played, and then the rest was spent trying to enjoy it. The main issue being the lack of monsters and variety to get genuine reactions. The point of the game is to get clips of funny moments during your trips to monster riddled maps. But without a large variety of things, reactions become dull as the gameplay loop becomes repetitive and the lack of new experiences directly translate into a lack of genuine moments to clip and enjoy. For the low price of the game I can still enjoy other things more than I did here.

claims.claim: Reviewers mention that flashlight batteries deplete too quickly and stamina runs out after only a few seconds of sprinting.

citations.review_text:
While I can't deny that this game might be worth it if you can get it on sale, I do think it gets a little boring after awhile. For one, it's hard finding people that actually want to enjoy the game as it is. It's better if you have friends to play with. If you join a random lobby, you'll either end up playing with a bunch of kids, or teenagers that will either kick you out or end up cussing the entire time. Honestly, it is some times better to be in a game with some of the kids.

Nothing you do carries over unless you're hosting a game. The flashlight battery doesn't last nearly as long as it should, and you're able to sprint for about 5 seconds before you run out of stamina. There are mods available for the game, but they only work if you're hosting and they seem to break as soon as random people join your game.

Like I said, if you want to try this game out, wait until it's on sale.
REPO but worse. The slow movement makes it jarring to play multiple times in a row, and the map layout doesn't change (at least from what I saw), so it feels repetitive and boring after a few games.

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Players note repetition and matchmaking hurdles alongside fun moments.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game lacks content, specifically noting a limited number of maps and gameplay that becomes repetitive after a few sessions.

citations.review_text: Fun to play for one or two sessions with a few friends, after that you've seen it all.

Game HAD so much potential. It was genuinely really fun at first, especially playing with someone else, but there’s just not enough content. We only ever got two maps, so it gets repetitive pretty quickly.
The progression is also annoying. The game auto-saves, but if everyone dies, you lose that run and get sent straight back to the beginning. There’s no way to save your progress during a run and continue from where you got to, which gets frustrating when you’ve already put time into it.
Such a good and funny concept that could’ve been developed into so much more, but it feels like they barely did anything with it.
Game HAD potential. Now it’s poo 💩

This game had a great idea going but just not enough content(haha get it). It only has like 2 maps, a lot of monsters which is good but you will get bored kinda quickly. If they added more maps and a few more mechanics it would have been peak, sad that they dropped this game a while ago.

not a lot of content in content warning. The first few games i played with my friends were really funny, but then there was nothing else, and it just became a pretty objectiveless game in my opinion. Hopefully they add more monsters and more map variety.

claims.claim: Reviewers experience bugs such as players falling out of the map, missing cameras, randomized reset of progression, and purchased items disappearing.

citations.review_text:
I really wanted to enjoy this game, but the amount of glitches and bugs we’ve encountered has made it extremely difficult to recommend.During one match, my friend literally **died and went out of the map**. The camera completely disappeared, and the game still counted it as a loss. Another friend was suddenly kicked out of the game for no apparent reason.The sponsor system also randomly reset, including the challenge where we had to deal 16k total damage and record it**. All that progress was suddenly gone.
We also spent our MC on the green screen and podcast booth**, only for the green screen to simply disappear during a gameplay session.And these are just a few examples. There are so many other glitches and bugs that I genuinely can't fit everything into a single review.I understand that bugs can happen, especially in a game that's still being developed, but when glitches are affecting progression, kicking players out, deleting purchased items, and turning matches into automatic losses, it becomes really frustrating.Currently, I cannot recommend this game. I hope the developers fix these issues because there is potential here, but right now the bugs are making the game more frustrating than fun.

The game is full of bugs. There has been no fixes and monster spawn rate exponentially increases from 128K. The players glitch constantly and sometimes fall off the map. I also cannot pick up any items sometimes. Yes it is fun to play with your friends but with the glitches constantly halt your progress. i would not personally recommend to play this game but if you can go past the glitches it can be "potentially" a good game.

claims.claim: Reviewers express a desire for more content updates, including additional monsters, maps, items, and a bestiary.

citations.review_text:
Was a real fun game, just wish the game had a bit more content(😱) in it
Also had better mod support and was a bit less buggy in some areas
Only reason i recommend is because it was pretty fun and i really enjoyed it in its prime

Very good game with friends BUT
Does get very repetitive if played for 30 or more hours and the content that it has isn't enough for the price compared to other friendslop games (Peak). Basically my only complaint is that they NEED to add more content to this game whether it would be more monsters or a new map or new items it just needs it desperately. But other from that this game is good.

I absolutely love this fricking game. 

The concept of risking your life just to film funny and scary moments is easily my favorite about it. Being able to watch back the exact footage your group captured, complete with everyone's voice chat and chaotic moments makes every run memorable and hilarious.

I also really like the progression of it. Earning MCs to buy new equipment, upgrades, cosmetics, and other items gives you a reason to keep coming back, and the variety of monsters keeps each expedition feeling fresh and unpredictable.

Things I think could improve the game a lot:

A bestiary for each monster you capture on film

And I guess that's about it
